title: CNSS D-skill capacity versus optimization-horizon controls
objective: Separate adapter capacity from optimization horizon as explanations for D's failure to fit its own training partition.
held_constant: batch size and deterministic batch schedule
gradient clipping and fail-closed numerical checks

authorization_boundary.required_before_execution: review the read-only acquisition report and explicitly authorize this separate control

interpretation_rule: No capacity or optimization conclusion is accepted unless training competence is reported alongside held-out accuracy and all checkpoint/replay gates pass.
